arabic text: Yeh subhe ashoor ka hai manzar Fiza Me gunji azaane akbar\nTarap gaya hai ali ka dilbar
english translation text: This is the scene of the morning of Ashura; Akbar's\nadhan echoes through the air, and Ali's beloved writhes in grief.

arabic text: Azaane akbar ka pehla jumla Fizaae karbobala me gunja\nFalak se taba zameen hai mehshar
english translation text: The first phrase of Akbar's adhan echoed across the atmosphere of Karbala;\nfrom the heavens to the earth, it was like Judgement Day.

arabic text: Azaane ibne hussain sunkar Baqi se zahra najaf se haider\nChale madine se hai payambar
english translation text: Hearing the adhan of Hussain's son, Zahra came from Baqi,\nHaider from Najaf, and the Prophet departed from Madina.

arabic text: Azaan jo karbobala me gunji\nHawa madine me leke pohnchi\nTarap ke chokat pe aayi khwaahar
english translation text: When the adhan echoed through Karbala,\nthe wind carried it to Madina;\nthe grieving sister came trembling to the doorway.

arabic text: Gawahi tawheed e kibriya ki\nRisalate fakhre ambiya ki\nWilayate shehnshahe khayber
english translation text: It bore witness to the oneness of the Almighty,\nthe Prophethood of the Pride of the Prophets,\nand the wilayah of the King of Khaybar.
The seventy-two stood arranged in rows.

arabic text: Pareshan qalbe shahe zaman hai\nPisar ki yeh aakhri azaan hai\nYehi hai lekin riza e dawar
english translation text: The heart of the King of the Age is distressed;\nthis is the son's final adhan,\nyet it is the will of the Lord.

arabic text: Tamam ansaar e ibne haider\nNazar hai guldastae azan par\nSafe banaye huwe bahatar
english translation text: All the companions of the son of Haider\nlooked towards the bouquet of the adhan;\nthe seventy-two stood arranged in rows.

arabic text: Azaan jo pohnchi mayaaane khaima\nJigar ko thame hai umme laila\nBarae akbar phupi hai muztar
english translation text: When the adhan reached the tents,\nUmm-e-Layla held her heart,\nand Akbar's aunt was overwhelmed with grief.

arabic text: Karim aur salman azmii hai\nFiza e karbobala me jaise\nYeh choda sadiyon se sawt akbar
english translation text: O "Karim" and "Salman Azmi",\nwithin the atmosphere of Karbala,\nAkbar's voice has echoed for fourteen centuries.
